plainText:
Andrew Paull is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Paull became affiliated with 4Kids Entertainment as a voice actor and worked in a few productions. He started working with the during , and his best-known role was as Steven Stone. Due to the Pokémon USA recasting controversy, Paull was initially unable to continue work on that show due to his ties with 4Kids. When Pokémon USA switched dubbing studios to DuArt Film & Video, this allowed Paull to reprise his role as Steven during and .
